module: Flowgraph node "Simple Button" (category once_instant): creates an all-in-one button whose values can no longer be changed. Inputs: "hideWhenDone" (disables the button after the first click), "label", "order" (hidden), "style" (hidden). Outputs: "clicked" (pulse), "used" / "unused" (hidden), "buttonId" (hidden).
notes: Bug: workOnce reads self.pinIn.active while the 'active' pin does not exist in pinSchema (nil -> index error); and the key passed to addButton is 'stlye' (typo), so the style is not passed.
Bug: work() uses button.used.value for hideWhenDone while the other lines use button.complete.
There are two definitions of C:workOnce; the second (empty) replaces the first.
On reset, the button is disabled, then re-enabled at the next work().

_executionStarted.desc: Resets hiddenAfterDone and hiddenAfterReset to false.

onNodeReset.desc: Disables the button (active=false) once and resets hiddenAfterDone to false.

postInit.desc: Defines the value template of the style pin.

work.desc: Re-enables the button after a reset, updates clicked/used/unused and disables it if hideWhenDone is set and it was already clicked.

workOnce.desc: Creates the button and writes its id (see notes: bugs).
